events.name: Awakening
events.info: Awakening at Wynn Las Vegas takes audiences on an immersive adventure, with a dynamic fusion of mind-bending illusions, captivating choreography, breathtaking puppetry, stunning acrobatics, and cutting-edge technology. The story follows IO, a reluctant heroine who travels through the realms of water, air, and earth to reunite Light and Darkness and restore balance to her world. The 80-minute production delivers a multisensory experience inside one of the world's most advanced 360-degree theaters, featuring a state-of-the-art glass stage enhanced by custom LED screens and visuals. Named "Best Production Show" by the Southern Nevada Hotel Concierge Association, Awakening Showcases 60 performers from around the world and is narrated by award winning actor Anthony Hopkins. The show is masterminded by creative visionaries Baz Halpin, Bernie Yuman, and Michael Curry.
events.pleaseNote: Doors for Awakening open 45 minutes before the 4:00 pm & 6:30 p.m. show and 30 minutes before the 7:00 pm & 9:00 p.m. show. Awakening runs 80 minutes with effects, including pyrotechnics, lighting, smoke, and sound. These elements may be disruptive to guests with certain conditions. Audience members may capture content on mobile devices, but no cameras or recording is permitted. Self-parking garages close to the theater are available at Wynn and Encore. Awakening is intended for ages 5 years or older; an adult must accompany children.

events.name: The Venetian Resort Gondolas
events.description:
Please read this section for important information including how to book a private gondola.
In a city like Las Vegas where everything is must-do, The Venetian Resort gondola rides can’t be missed. Float down the Grand Canal underneath bridges and past cafes while a singing gondolier pilots your journey.
Tour the indoor route of the Grand Canal across shimmering water, past the Shoppes. Always great for couples, our gondola rides are a favorite activity among families and an extra fun thing to do in Vegas with kids.  
Same day reservations are NOT available online. Visit Emporio d' Gondola or the outdoor gondola ticketing booth.  

All sales are FINAL.  Please carefully confirm correct date, time, and quantity before completing purchase.  

IT IS STRONGLY ADVISED TO AVOID BOOKING ON DAY OF TRAVEL.  MISSED RESERVATION TIMES DUE TO TRAVEL DELAYS ARE NOT ELIGIBLE FOR REFUND, CREDIT, OR RESCHEDULING. 

Indoor Gondola Rides
Emporio D' Gondola Level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes


Last Gondola leaves the dock 15 minutes prior to closing.
Pricing and hours subject to change without notice.

All tickets are general admission, and guests may be paired with others.  To assure a private boat, please purchase all four tickets for your desired time slot.  Purchase all tickets for the same boat number (unless purchasing for a group of 5 or more). Do not combine tickets from multiple boats.  Your party WILL be separated.

All passengers over 2 years old require tickets.  Children up to 24 months are free but count toward total number of passengers.  4 MAXIMUM. No exceptions. 

For information on our gondola wedding packages, please contact Venetian Weddings. 
Email: Weddings@VenetianLasVegas.com

events.name: X Burlesque
events.info: The most provocative show on the Las Vegas Strip, X Burlesque, celebrates 10 years as the city's hottest topless revue. A high-energy, sexy performance set inside the X Showroom at Flamingo Las Vegas, X Burlesque features a variety of jaw-dropping performances by a troupe of gorgeous dancers, set to music by today's hottest artists. In celebration of the show's 10th anniversary, several new dance numbers have been added to the show, including "Champagne Wishes," a classic striptease performed inside a traditional burlesque champagne glass to Michael Buble's "Fever," "Sexy Silk" by Jessica Cornish and "Mirror, Mirror," a tribute to famous burlesque dancer Sally Rand, performed to Aerosmith's "Dream On." For 75 minutes, the burlesque beauties bare their assets while teasing, seducing and playfully interacting with the audience. X Burlesque combines high-energy performance with the use of outrageous props such as bathtubs, guitars, and feather boas to fulfill the audience's every fantasy.

events.name: Willie Barcena at Laugh Factory Las Vegas
events.info: The World-Famous Hollywood Laugh Factory brings its iconic brand of comedy nightly to Horseshoe Las Vegas. Founded in 1979, the Laugh Factory has been recognized as the "#1 comedy club in the country" by USA Today and is known for launching some of the biggest names in stand-up, including Tim Allen, Tiffany Haddish, Dane Cook, Matt Rife, Adam Ray, Drew Carey, Sarah Silverman, Bobby Lee, Brad Williams, and more. Legendary performers such as George Carlin, Jim Carrey, Dave Chappelle, Rodney Dangerfield, Jay Leno, Eddie Murphy, Richard Pryor, Chris Rock, Jerry Seinfeld, and Robin Williams have also graced its stage. With locations in Hollywood, Long Beach, Covina, San Diego, Chicago, Reno - and now Horseshoe Las Vegas - the Laugh Factory features 3 new comedians every week and 2 shows nightly at 8:30pm & 10:30pm. Visit LaughFactory.com.

events.name: High Roller Wheel at The LINQ
events.info: Shining bright on the Las Vegas Strip, the 550 foot tall High Roller is the world's largest observation wheel. This stunning Las Vegas attraction provides tourists and locals alike the ride of a lifetime. The epic wheel is the crown jewel of The LINQ, the Strip's all new outdoor shopping, dining and entertainment district. The High Roller has 28 spherical, Italian handcrafted glass enclosed cabins, each weighing 4,000 pounds. Passengers can enjoy breathtaking Las Vegas views in a 30 minute ride, the time it takes for the entire wheel to rotate. Additionally, each air-conditioned cabin is equipped with two benches for seating. Each stylish, modern-styled cabin holds up to 40 people, totaling 1,120 at full capacity. Whether flying solo or renting out a cabin for a wedding or private party, each 4,000 pound pod features dynamic music and video shows as riders take in the 360 degree sights.
events.pleaseNote: Admission ticket good for ONE ride NON-TRANSFERABLE / NONREFUNDABLE / VOID IF ALTERED/NOT FOR RESALE OR EXCHANGE. Tickets may be valid for one time use only, and valid up to 3 days for redemption. Attraction may close due to refurbishing, capacity, weather or special events. Caesars LINQ, LLC (Owner) reserves the right to change operating hours and/or other specifics of the ride or to discontinue service without notice and without liability to Owner or its affiliates. Not valid for separately ticketed special events. You are required to comply with all safety rules and are cautioned to heed all warnings. HOURS OF OPERATION: Open 7 Days a Week, Monday-Thursday 12pm - 12am, Friday-Sunday 12pm - 2am. Ride like a VIP! Cabin and wheel buyouts for Private Parties and Corporate Events are available. For more information, email highrollersales@caesars.com. The venue reserves the right to implement security procedures designed to protect the experience for our customers.

events.name: Real Bodies
events.info: REAL BODIES uses real human specimens to explore the complex innerworkings of the human form in a refreshing and thought-provoking style. System by system, the Exhibition provides an approachable and fascinating insight into what's happening inside every one of us. REALBODIES also explores how elements such as breathing, hunger, the rhythm of the heart, and other essential body functions have deep cultural and emotional significance that reach as far back as the dawn of humanity. Children 3 and under are free while ages 3 - 12 require a Youth Ticket.
events.pleaseNote: REAL BODIES HOURS OF OPERATION: Open 7 days a week -- Friday-Monday: 11:00 AM -- 7:30 PM (Last guest in at 6:30pm) Tuesday-Thursday: 11:00 AM -- 6:30 PM (Last guest in at 5:30pm) (Self-guided tour takes 30-45 min). events.pleaseNote: The Eiffel Tower is open Daily, 4pm-12am. Experience the breathtaking view from the single most romantic spot in all of Las Vegas. A signature of the Las Vegas skyline and one of the best things to do in Las Vegas, the Eiffel Tower Ride at Paris Las Vegas is a replica of one of Europe's most famous landmarks. This Las Vegas attraction is located in the heart of the Las Vegas Strip, 46 stories above the city. On your journey to the observation deck of the Eiffel Tower Ride, our knowledgeable Ambassadors will point out unforgettable Las Vegas landmarks.
